About

Who you're working with

about_george.md

I'm George Rios — edge architect and Cloudflare specialist with 25 years of enterprise architecture experience.

I spent years building complex systems at scale. Today I go deep on the Cloudflare Edge while working across the broader modern stack — helping startups and teams ship production software fast.

As a fractional CTO, I plug into founding teams and existing engineering orgs as a strategic technical partner — without the full-time price tag. I set architecture direction, defragment sprawling stacks, review PRs, mentor senior engineers, manage vendor and cloud relationships, align roadmap with business goals, and make the calls that have been deferred. I work best with founders who need someone who has been there before, can ship with the team, and can translate between product, engineering, and the board.

Creator of Noundry, NounJS, and Levi libraries.
